sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: GitHub - juhanimerilehto/llm-quantization-gguf: A comprehensive Windows ...
sources.snippet: A comprehensive Windows-optimized tool for downloading, converting, and quantizing the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model to GGUF format. This project provides a structured approach to model quantization with separate scripts for each phase of the process, specifically designed for Windows environments. Enables offline, privacy-preserving analysis of i.e., sports, exercise, or organization-related data ...
